---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL HRNat == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction

\* The configuration argument is independent of the entry payload types.
\* An existential element set lets us retain just the sequence structure.
HRSeq(q) == \E S : q \in Seq(S)

LEMMA HRSeqFacts ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q)
  PROVE Len(q) \in Nat
BY LenProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HREmpty == HRSeq(<<>>) /\ Len(<<>>) = 0
BY EmptySeq DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW e
  PROVE /\ HRSeq(Append(q,e))
        /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
        /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,e)[k] = q[k]
        /\ Append(q,e)[Len(q)+1] = e
<1>1. PICK S : q \in Seq(S) BY DEF HRSeq
<1>2. q \in Seq(S \cup {e})
  BY <1>1, SeqMonotonic
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, AppendProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRSubSeq ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
  PROVE HRSeq(SubSeq(q,a,b))
<1>1. \A k \in a..b : q[k] \in {q[j] : j \in a..b}
  BY SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SubSeqProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRConcat ==
  ASSUME NEW q, NEW r, HRSeq(q), HRSeq(r)
  PROVE HRSeq(q \o r)
<1>1. PICK S : q \in Seq(S) BY DEF HRSeq
<1>2. PICK T : r \in Seq(T) BY DEF HRSeq
<1>3. q \in Seq(S \cup T) /\ r \in Seq(S \cup T)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SeqMonotonic
<1>4. QED BY <1>3, ConcatProperties DEF HRSeq

LEMMA HRFirstGap ==
 ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW P(_)
 PROVE \E k \in 1..(n+1) :
          /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) : P(j)
          /\ k = n+1 \/ ~P(k)
<1>1. DEFINE Bad(k) == k \in 1..(n+1) /\ (k = n+1 \/ ~P(k))
<1>2. n+1 \in Nat /\ Bad(n+1) BY SMTT("r5") DEF Bad
<1>2a. HIDE DEF Bad
<1>3. PICK k \in Nat : Bad(k) /\ \A j \in 0..(k-1) : ~Bad(j)
  BY <1>2, HRNat!SmallestNatural, Isa
<1>4. QED BY <1>3, SMTT("r5") DEF Bad

LEMMA HRMerge ==
 ASSUME NEW q, NEW r, NEW p \in Int, HRSeq(q), HRSeq(r)
 PROVE HRSeq(MergeEntries(q,p,r))
<1>1. Len(q) \in Nat /\ Len(r) \in Nat BY HRSeqFacts
<1>2. DEFINE Same(j) == p+j <= Len(q) /\ q[p+j].term = r[j].term
            K == CHOOSE k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
                   /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
                         /\ p+j <= Len(q)
                         /\ q[p+j].term = r[j].term
                   /\ \/ k = Len(r)+1
                      \/ p+k > Len(q)
                      \/ q[p+k].term /= r[k].term
<1>2a. HIDE DEF Same, K
<1>3. \E k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
        /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) : Same(j)
        /\ k = Len(r)+1 \/ p+k > Len(q) \/ q[p+k].term /= r[k].term
  <2>1. \E k \in 1..(Len(r)+1) :
           /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) : Same(j)
           /\ k = Len(r)+1 \/ ~Same(k)
    BY <1>1, HRFirstGap, Isa
  <2>2. QED BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r5") DEF Same
<1>4. K \in 1..(Len(r)+1) BY <1>3, SMTT("r5") DEF K, Same
<1>5. HRSeq(SubSeq(q,1,p+K-1)) /\ HRSeq(SubSeq(r,K,Len(r)))
  BY <1>1, <1>4, HRSubSeq, SMTT("r5")
<1>5a. HRSeq(SubSeq(q,1,p+K-1) \o SubSeq(r,K,Len(r)))
  BY <1>5, HRConcat
<1>5b. MergeEntries(q,p,r) =
        IF Len(r) = 0 THEN q
        ELSE IF K = Len(r)+1 THEN q
        ELSE SubSeq(q,1,p+K-1) \o SubSeq(r,K,Len(r))
  BY DEF MergeEntries, K
<1>6. QED BY <1>5a, <1>5b, SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRMaximum ==
 ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW S \in SUBSET (1..n), S # {}
 PROVE /\ SetMax(S) \in S
       /\ \A k \in S : k <= SetMax(S)
<1>1. DEFINE B(d) == d \in 0..n /\ n-d \in S
<1>2. PICK z \in S : TRUE BY SMTT("r5")
<1>2a. n-z \in Nat /\ B(n-z) BY <1>2, SMTT("r5") DEF B
<1>2b. \E d \in Nat : B(d) BY <1>2a

<1>2c. HIDE DEF B
<1>3. PICK d \in Nat : B(d) /\ \A j \in 0..(d-1) : ~B(j)
  BY <1>2b, HRNat!SmallestNatural, Isa
<1>4. \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
  <2>1. n-d \in S BY <1>3 DEF B
  <2>2. ASSUME NEW y \in S PROVE n-d >= y
    <3>1. n-y \in 0..n /\ B(n-y)
      BY SMTT("r5") DEF B
    <3>2. QED BY <1>3, <3>1, SMTT("r5") DEF B
  <2>3. n-d \in S /\ \A y \in S : n-d >= y BY <2>1, <2>2
  <2>4. QED BY <2>3
<1>5. QED BY <1>4, SMTT("r5") DEF SetMax

LEMMA HRConfigFacts ==
 ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q)
 PROVE /\ LastConfigIndex(q) \in 0..Len(q)
       /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in 0..LastConfigIndex(q)
       /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= LastConfigIndex(q)
       /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
                k <= PreviousConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. Len(q) \in Nat BY HRSeqFacts
<1>2. ConfigIndices(q) \subseteq 1..Len(q)
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF ConfigIndices
<1>3. ConfigIndices(q) # {} =>
        /\ SetMax(ConfigIndices(q)) \in ConfigIndices(q)
        /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) : k <= SetMax(ConfigIndices(q))
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRMaximum
<1>4. ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} # {} =>
        /\ SetMax(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
             \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)}
        /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} :
             k <= SetMax(ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)})
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRMaximum, SMTT("r5")
<1>5. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, SMTT("r5")
  DEF LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex

LEMMA HRConfigAppend ==
 ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW e
 PROVE /\ ConfigIndices(Append(q,e)) =
            IF e.type = ConfigEntry THEN ConfigIndices(q) \cup {Len(q)+1}
            ELSE ConfigIndices(q)
       /\ LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) =
            IF e.type = ConfigEntry THEN Len(q)+1 ELSE LastConfigIndex(q)
       /\ PreviousConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) =
            IF e.type = ConfigEntry THEN LastConfigIndex(q) ELSE PreviousConfigIndex(q)
<1>1. Len(q) \in Nat BY HRSeqFacts
<1>2. HRSeq(Append(q,e)) /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
       /\ (\A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,e)[k] = q[k])
       /\ Append(q,e)[Len(q)+1] = e
  BY HRAppend
<1>3. ConfigIndices(Append(q,e)) =
        IF e.type = ConfigEntry THEN ConfigIndices(q) \cup {Len(q)+1}
        ELSE ConfigIndices(q)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r10") DEF ConfigIndices
<1>4. CASE e.type # ConfigEntry
  BY <1>3, <1>4 DEF LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex
<1>5. CASE e.type = ConfigEntry
  <2>1. LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>5, HRConfigFacts, SMTT("r10") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>2. ConfigIndices(Append(q,e)) \ {LastConfigIndex(Append(q,e))} = ConfigIndices(q)
    BY <1>1, <1>3, <2>1, SMTT("r5") DEF ConfigIndices
  <2>3. QED BY <1>3, <1>5, <2>1, <2>2 DEF PreviousConfigIndex, LastConfigIndex
<1>6. QED BY <1>4, <1>5


\* Every configuration except the latest lies at or below c.  In particular,
\* restoring c to the penultimate configuration index after a crash suffices.
HRLocal(q,c,l) ==
  /\ HRSeq(q)
  /\ c \in Int
  /\ l = LastConfigIndex(q)
  /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= c

HRMsg(m) ==
  /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesRequest =>
       /\ m.mprevLogIndex \in Int
       /\ HRSeq(m.mentries)
       /\ m.mcommitIndex \in Nat)
  /\ (m.mtype = AppendEntriesResponse => m.mmatchIndex \in Int)

HRMessages(B) == \A m \in DOMAIN B : HRMsg(m)

HRCore ==
  /\ DOMAIN log = Server
  /\ DOMAIN latestConfigIndex = Server
  /\ DOMAIN committedConfigIndex = Server
  /\ \A s \in Server :
         HRLocal(log[s], committedConfigIndex[s], latestConfigIndex[s])

HRIndices ==
  /\ commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ nextIndex \in [Server -> [Server -> Int]]

\* The index and message clauses provide the typing facts needed when a
\* received batch is merged.  HRCore tracks the configuration-index metadata.
HRInv == HRCore /\ HRIndices /\ HRMessages(messages)

LEMMA HRCardThree ==
 \A a,b,c : Cardinality({a,b,c}) <= 3
<1>1. TAKE a,b,c
<1>2. {a,b} = {a} \cup {b} /\ {a,b,c} = {a,b} \cup {c}
  BY SMTT("r5")
<1>3. IsFiniteSet({a,b}) /\ Cardinality({a,b}) <= 2
  BY <1>2, FS_Singleton, FS_AddElement, SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, FS_AddElement, FS_CardinalityType, SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRMessageKinds ==
 /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesRequest
 /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
 /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesRequest
 /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesResponse
 /\ AppendEntriesRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
<1>1. Cardinality({RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse,
                  AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}) = 4
  BY MessageDomain
<1>2. ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, NEW c, NEW d,
             Cardinality({a,b,c,d}) = 4
       PROVE a # b /\ a # c /\ a # d /\ b # c /\ b # d /\ c # d
  <2>1. a = b => {a,b,c,d} = {b,c,d} BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. a = c => {a,b,c,d} = {b,c,d} BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>3. a = d => {a,b,c,d} = {b,c,d} BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>4. b = c => {a,b,c,d} = {a,c,d} BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>5. b = d => {a,b,c,d} = {a,c,d} BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>6. c = d => {a,b,c,d} = {a,b,d} BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>7. QED BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, HRCardThree, SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA HRBagDomains ==
 ASSUME NEW B, NEW C, NEW S
 PROVE /\ DOMAIN(B (+) C) = DOMAIN B \cup DOMAIN C
       /\ DOMAIN(B (-) C) \subseteq DOMAIN B
       /\ DOMAIN SetToBag(S) = S
BY SMTT("r5") DEF (+), (-), SetToBag

LEMMA HRMessageOps ==
 ASSUME NEW B, NEW m, NEW S, HRMessages(B), \A x \in S : HRMsg(x)
 PROVE /\ HRMessages(B (+) SetToBag(S))
       /\ HRMessages(B (-) SetToBag({m}))
       /\ HRMessages((B (-) SetToBag({m})) (+) SetToBag(S))
BY HRBagDomains, SMTT("r5") DEF HRMessages

LEMMA HRLocalEmpty == HRLocal(<<>>,0,0)
BY HREmpty, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLocal, ConfigIndices, LastConfigIndex, PreviousConfigIndex

LEMMA HRLocalAppend ==
 ASSUME NEW q, NEW c, NEW l, NEW e, HRLocal(q,c,l)
 PROVE /\ (e.type # ConfigEntry => HRLocal(Append(q,e),c,l))
       /\ (e.type = ConfigEntry /\ c = l => HRLocal(Append(q,e),c,Len(Append(q,e))))
                         
<1>1. HRSeq(q) /\ c \in Int /\ l = LastConfigIndex(q)
       /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= c
  BY DEF HRLocal
<1>2. HRSeq(Append(q,e)) /\ Len(Append(q,e)) = Len(q)+1
  BY <1>1, HRAppend
<1>3. e.type # ConfigEntry => HRLocal(Append(q,e),c,l)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRConfigAppend, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLocal
<1>4. e.type = ConfigEntry /\ c = l =>
          HRLocal(Append(q,e),c,Len(Append(q,e)))
  BY <1>1, <1>2, HRConfigAppend, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLocal
<1>5. QED BY <1>3, <1>4, SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRLocalReset ==
 ASSUME NEW q, HRSeq(q), NEW c \in Int, NEW t \in Nat
 PROVE /\ HRLocal(q,PreviousConfigIndex(q),LastConfigIndex(q))
       /\ HRLocal(q, IF LastConfigIndex(q) <= t THEN LastConfigIndex(q)
                     ELSE Max(PreviousConfigIndex(q),Min(c,LastConfigIndex(q))),
                     LastConfigIndex(q))
BY HRConfigFacts, HRSeqFacts, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLocal, Min, Max

LEMMA HRLocalCommit ==
 ASSUME NEW q, NEW c, NEW l, NEW t, HRLocal(q,c,l)
 PROVE HRLocal(q, IF l <= t THEN l ELSE c, l)
BY HRConfigFacts, HRSeqFacts, SMTT("r5") DEF HRLocal

LEMMA HRLocalSafety ==
 ASSUME NEW q, NEW c, NEW l, NEW t \in Nat, HRLocal(q,c,l)
 PROVE Cardinality({k \in (Max(t,c)+1)..Len(q) : q[k].type = ConfigEntry}) <= 1
<1>1. HRSeq(q) /\ c \in Int /\ l = LastConfigIndex(q)
       /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) <= c
  BY DEF HRLocal
<1>2. Len(q) \in Nat /\ PreviousConfigIndex(q) \in Nat
       /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(q) \ {LastConfigIndex(q)} : k <= PreviousConfigIndex(q)
  BY <1>1, HRConfigFacts, HRSeqFacts
<1>3. {k \in (Max(t,c)+1)..Len(q) : q[k].type = ConfigEntry} \subseteq {l}
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in (Max(t,c)+1)..Len(q), q[k].type = ConfigEntry
                PROVE k = l
    BY SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. k \in ConfigIndices(q) /\ k > c
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>1, SMTT("r5") DEF ConfigIndices, Max
  <2>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>2, SMTT("r5")
<1>4. QED BY <1>3, FS_Subset, FS_Singleton, SMTT("r5")

LEMMA HRInit == Init => HRInv
BY HRLocalEmpty, HREmpty, SMTT("r10")
 DEF Init, ProtocolInit, HRInv, HRCore, HRIndices, HRMessages, EmptyBag, SetToBag


LEMMA HRCoreData == HRCore =>
  \A s \in Server :
    /\ HRSeq(log[s])
    /\ Len(log[s]) \in Nat
    /\ committedConfigIndex[s] \in Int
BY HRSeqFacts, SMTT("r5") DEF HRCore, HRLocal

LEMMA HRCommitType ==
 \A c,d,n \in Nat : (IF d > c THEN Min(d,n) ELSE c) \in Nat
BY SMTT("r5") DEF Min

LEMMA HRStepTimeout ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, Timeout(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, Timeout, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, Timeout, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY HRBagDomains, HRMessageKinds, HRCoreData, HRSeqFacts, HRSubSeq, HREmpty, SMTT("r10")
  DEF HRInv, HRIndices, Timeout, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, Send, SendAll, Reply, Discard, LastLogIndex
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepBecomeLeader ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, BecomeLeader(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, BecomeLeader, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY HRCoreData, SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, BecomeLeader, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, BecomeLeader
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepCompletePersistVote ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, CompletePersistVote(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, CompletePersistVote, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, CompletePersistVote, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY HRBagDomains, HRMessageKinds, HRCoreData, HRSeqFacts, HRSubSeq, HREmpty, SMTT("r10")
  DEF HRInv, HRIndices, CompletePersistVote, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, Send, SendAll, Reply, Discard, LastLogIndex
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepCheckLeaderLease ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, CheckLeaderLease(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, CheckLeaderLease, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, CheckLeaderLease, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, CheckLeaderLease
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepDiskBlock ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, DiskBlock(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, DiskBlock, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, DiskBlock, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, DiskBlock
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepDiskUnblock ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, DiskUnblock(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, DiskUnblock, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, DiskUnblock, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, DiskUnblock
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepCrash ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, Crash(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY HRLocalReset, HRCoreData, SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, Crash, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY HREmpty, SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, Crash, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, Crash
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepAdvanceCommitIndex ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, HRInv, AdvanceCommitIndex(i)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY HRLocalCommit, SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, AdvanceCommitIndex, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY HRCoreData, HRMaximum, SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, AdvanceCommitIndex, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, AdvanceCommitIndex
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepClientRequest ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW v \in Values, HRInv, ClientRequest(i,v)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY HRLocalAppend, EntryDomain, SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, ClientRequest, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, ClientRequest, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF HRInv, ClientRequest
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF HRInv

LEMMA HRStepReplicateEntries ==
 ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, HRInv, ReplicateEntries(i,j)
 PROVE HRInv'
<1>1. HRCore'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRCore, ReplicateEntries, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg
<1>2. HRIndices'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF HRInv, HRIndices, ReplicateEntries, serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, HRMessages, HRMsg, LastLogIndex, Min, Max
<1>3. HRMessages(messages')
